{"ambiguities": [
{"id": "88:2b", "words": "a vossa verdade", "readings": ["the truth (true doctrine, facts) you reveal", "your faithfulness, your being true to your word"], "likelyHeard": "truth as true teaching; the faithfulness sense is not obvious (applies throughout: 88:3, 6, 9, 15, 25, 34, 50)"},
{"id": "88:3", "words": "a misericórdia será edificada nos céus", "readings": ["mercy will be built up/established permanently in heaven", "mercy will be built (constructed) like a building up in the sky"], "likelyHeard": "a vague image of mercy being built in heaven; the sense 'firmly established' is not clear"},
{"id": "88:3", "words": "Porque dissestes: ... Firmei aliança (88:4)", "readings": ["the psalmist is still speaking about God in 88:3 and God starts speaking in 88:4", "everything after 'dissestes:' is God's speech"], "likelyHeard": "unclear where the quotation starts; with no audible marks, the switch to God speaking in first person at 88:4 ('meus escolhidos') is noticed late"},
{"id": "88:4", "words": "prepararei a tua descendência", "readings": ["I will establish your descendants (as a dynasty)", "I will get your descendants ready for something"], "likelyHeard": "get ready/prepare, a weaker sense than 'establish'"},
{"id": "88:6", "words": "e também pela vossa verdade na assembleia dos santos", "readings": ["the heavens will give thanks, in the assembly of the saints, for your truth", "they give thanks for your truth, which is present in the assembly of the saints", "the assembly of the saints (not the heavens) gives thanks"], "likelyHeard": "the heavens give thanks for your truth, and the assembly of the saints is a vague place added on"},
{"id": "88:7", "words": "quem nas nuvens se igualará ao Senhor", "readings": ["who, among those in the clouds (heavenly beings), will equal the Lord?", "who will be equal to the Lord up in the clouds (a place where the comparison happens)?"], "likelyHeard": "who up in the clouds is equal to the Lord; OK, but 'in the clouds' may sound like a place, not a group of beings"},
{"id": "88:7", "words": "filhos de Deus", "readings": ["angels or heavenly beings", "believers, God's children in the Christian sense"], "likelyHeard": "believers or people, not angels"},
{"id": "88:7", "words": "Porque quem ... será semelhante", "readings": ["a rhetorical question: 'For who...?'", "the start of a statement: 'because the one who...'"], "likelyHeard": "a question, if it is read with a questioning tone; 'Porque' at the start, followed by a colon, makes it hard to hear as one"},
{"id": "88:8", "words": "terrível", "readings": ["awe-inspiring, to be feared", "horrible, very bad (the common spoken meaning)"], "likelyHeard": "'horrible' can come to mind; in church most would take it as fearsome"},
{"id": "88:8", "words": "todos os que estão ao redor dele", "readings": ["the heavenly court around God", "anyone near him, neighbouring peoples"], "likelyHeard": "vague: whoever is around him"},
{"id": "88:8", "words": "conselho dos santos", "readings": ["the council/assembly of the holy ones", "the advice/counsel given by the saints"], "likelyHeard": "'conselho' is often heard as advice; the sense of an assembly is less obvious"},
{"id": "88:9", "words": "Deus dos poderes", "readings": ["God of the hosts/armies (heavenly powers)", "God of strengths or abilities in the abstract"], "likelyHeard": "powers as abstract strength"},
{"id": "88:9", "words": "a vossa verdade está ao vosso redor", "readings": ["your faithfulness surrounds you like a garment or retinue", "truth is somewhere around you"], "likelyHeard": "an unclear image; it is accepted without being understood"},
{"id": "88:10", "words": "movimento das suas ondas", "readings": ["the sea's waves", "someone else's waves"], "likelyHeard": "the sea's waves (little real doubt)"},
{"id": "88:11", "words": "o soberbo", "readings": ["a proud person in general", "a specific proud enemy or monster (for example the sea power)"], "likelyHeard": "a proud person in general"},
{"id": "88:11", "words": "como a um ferido", "readings": ["you humbled him the way one humbles a wounded man (he is laid low like the slain)", "you humbled him while he was wounded, or he became like a wounded man"], "likelyHeard": "loosely 'you struck him down like a wounded man'; the construction is not clear"},
{"id": "88:12", "words": "o norte e o mar", "readings": ["north and south (the whole earth), with 'mar' standing for a compass point", "the north and the literal sea"], "likelyHeard": "the north and the sea, a pairing that seems odd"},
{"id": "88:12", "words": "o mundo e a sua plenitude, vós os fundastes", "readings": ["'os' refers to the heavens, the earth and the world together", "'os' refers only to the world and its fullness"], "likelyHeard": "everything just named"},
{"id": "88:13", "words": "vosso é o braço com potência", "readings": ["yours is the mighty arm", "yours is the arm, (which comes) with power"], "likelyHeard": "yours is the mighty arm"},
{"id": "88:14", "words": "Firme-se a vossa mão, e exalte-se a vossa direita", "readings": ["a wish: may your hand be strong, may your right hand be lifted up", "a statement: your hand is strong", "'exalte-se' as a reflexive command: exalt yourself"], "likelyHeard": "a wish/prayer, though the -se forms are hard to take in by ear"},
{"id": "88:14", "words": "a vossa direita", "readings": ["your right hand", "'the right' in another sense (right side, political right)"], "likelyHeard": "right hand, given 'mão' just before"},
{"id": "88:14", "words": "a justiça e o juízo", "readings": ["justice and judgment (just rule)", "justice and good sense/sanity ('juízo' in everyday speech)"], "likelyHeard": "justice and judgment, maybe with a touch of 'good sense'"},
{"id": "88:14", "words": "a preparação do vosso trono", "readings": ["the foundation/base of your throne", "the act of getting your throne ready"], "likelyHeard": "getting the throne ready; the sense 'foundation' is lost"},
{"id": "88:15", "words": "conhece a aclamação", "readings": ["the people who know how to acclaim/shout for joy to God", "the people who know about (have heard) some acclamation", "a liturgical acclamation (as in Mass)"], "likelyHeard": "unclear; may think of the Mass acclamations"},
{"id": "88:16", "words": "andarão ... exultarão ... serão exaltados", "readings": ["the subject is the blessed people of 88:15", "the subject is some other group"], "likelyHeard": "the people of 88:15, though the subject is never said aloud"},
{"id": "88:18", "words": "a glória do poder deles", "readings": ["'deles' = the blessed people of 88:15-16", "'deles' = some other group"], "likelyHeard": "the people, though the switch from 'deles' to 'nosso' in the same verse is confusing"},
{"id": "88:18", "words": "será exaltado o nosso chifre", "readings": ["our horn = our strength or power (biblical image)", "a literal animal horn", "'chifre' in Brazilian slang = being cheated on by a spouse ('levar chifre')"], "likelyHeard": "many listeners will think of the slang sense and find it odd or funny; few know the image of the horn as strength"},
{"id": "88:19", "words": "Porque do Senhor é o nosso amparo, e do Santo de Israel, nosso rei", "readings": ["our shield belongs to the Lord, and our king belongs to the Holy One of Israel", "our help comes from the Lord, and from the Holy One of Israel, who is our king"], "likelyHeard": "the second: the Holy One of Israel is our king"},
{"id": "88:20", "words": "aos vossos santos", "readings": ["your faithful ones or prophets", "the canonized saints"], "likelyHeard": "saints in the Catholic sense"},
{"id": "88:20", "words": "Pus o auxílio num poderoso", "readings": ["I have given help to (or laid help upon) a mighty man", "I have put my help (my trust) in someone powerful"], "likelyHeard": "unclear; could be heard as God relying on a powerful person"},
{"id": "88:22", "words": "Pois a minha mão o ajudará", "readings": ["'o' = David", "'o' = the people"], "likelyHeard": "David"},
{"id": "88:23", "words": "não voltará a fazer-lhe mal", "readings": ["will not harm him again (implying it already harmed him)", "will not be able to harm him at all"], "likelyHeard": "'not again', implying earlier harm"},
{"id": "88:23", "words": "o filho da iniquidade", "readings": ["a wicked person (Hebrew idiom)", "the literal son of some evil person"], "likelyHeard": "a wicked man"},
{"id": "88:24", "words": "diante dele os seus inimigos", "readings": ["David's enemies, destroyed in his presence", "the enemies' own ... (seus = theirs)"], "likelyHeard": "David's enemies"},
{"id": "88:25", "words": "será exaltado o seu chifre", "readings": ["his strength/power will be exalted", "a literal horn; or the slang sense of being cheated on"], "likelyHeard": "the slang sense may come to mind; the strength sense is not known"},
{"id": "88:26", "words": "porei no mar a sua mão ... e nos rios a sua direita", "readings": ["I will extend his rule to the sea and the rivers", "I will literally place his hand in the sea"], "likelyHeard": "a puzzling literal image; the sense 'rule' is not obvious"},
{"id": "88:27", "words": "o amparo da minha salvação", "readings": ["the one who supports and saves me", "a support for my salvation (in the spiritual sense)"], "likelyHeard": "my support and salvation"},
{"id": "88:29", "words": "a minha aliança lhe será fiel", "readings": ["my covenant with him will stand firm", "the covenant will be loyal to him, as if the covenant were a person"], "likelyHeard": "my covenant with him will be kept"},
{"id": "88:30", "words": "como os dias do céu", "readings": ["as long as the heavens last", "like the weather or days in the sky"], "likelyHeard": "loosely 'eternal', but not clear"},
{"id": "88:32", "words": "profanarem as minhas justiças", "readings": ["break my statutes/ordinances", "defile my just acts or my righteousness"], "likelyHeard": "unclear; 'justiças' in the plural is not heard as 'laws'"},
{"id": "88:33", "words": "Visitarei com a vara", "readings": ["I will punish with the rod", "I will literally visit, carrying a stick", "'vara' as a court (judicial 'vara')"], "likelyHeard": "punishment with a rod, though 'visitar' as 'punish' sounds odd"},
{"id": "88:33", "words": "as suas iniquidades", "readings": ["the sons' iniquities", "David's iniquities"], "likelyHeard": "the sons'"},
{"id": "88:34", "words": "não retirarei dele a minha misericórdia", "readings": ["'dele' = David", "'dele' = the sons who sinned (singular mismatch)"], "likelyHeard": "David, though the plural sons were just mentioned"},
{"id": "88:34", "words": "nem farei mal na minha verdade", "readings": ["nor will I be false to my faithfulness/promise", "nor will I do harm by means of my truth", "nor will I do evil (commit wrong) in my truthfulness"], "likelyHeard": "obscure; 'will not break my word' is not what the listener hears"},
{"id": "88:35", "words": "não o tornarei vão", "readings": ["I will not make void what I have said (I will keep my word)", "I will not make it vain or useless in another sense"], "likelyHeard": "I won't take back my word"},
{"id": "88:36", "words": "Uma vez jurei", "readings": ["once and for all I swore", "one time, once in the past, I swore"], "likelyHeard": "'on one occasion', which weakens the finality"},
{"id": "88:36", "words": "a sua descendência", "readings": ["David's descendants", "God's"], "likelyHeard": "David's"},
{"id": "88:37", "words": "e testemunha fiel no céu", "readings": ["the moon is a faithful witness in the sky", "God is the faithful witness in heaven", "the throne is a faithful witness"], "likelyHeard": "unclear; it seems to be tacked on"},
{"id": "88:37", "words": "à minha vista", "readings": ["in my sight, before me", "'à vista' = cash payment, or 'within view'"], "likelyHeard": "in my sight"},
{"id": "88:37", "words": "a lua perfeita", "readings": ["the full moon", "a flawless moon"], "likelyHeard": "a perfect moon, not specifically full"},
{"id": "88:39", "words": "repelistes e desdenhastes", "readings": ["you rejected and scorned (the king / your people)", "no object: rejected in general"], "likelyHeard": "no object can be heard; presumably the anointed, named later"},
{"id": "88:39", "words": "adiastes o vosso Cristo", "readings": ["you have put off/delayed your anointed one", "you have rejected or deferred him (cast off)", "you postponed Christ (Jesus)"], "likelyHeard": "that God 'postponed Christ', which is confusing; 'Cristo' will be heard as Jesus, not the anointed king"},

{"id": "88:40", "words": "o seu santuário", "readings": ["the servant's (king's) holy place or crown", "God's sanctuary"], "likelyHeard": "the servant's sanctuary, or a temple"},
{"id": "88:41", "words": "fizestes da sua fortaleza um pavor", "readings": ["you turned his stronghold into ruins that inspire dread", "you made his strength (fortaleza = fortitude) a fear"], "likelyHeard": "'fortaleza' may be heard as fortitude or strength rather than a fortress"},
{"id": "88:42", "words": "Saquearam-no ... tornou-se", "readings": ["'no' and the subject of 'tornou-se' = the king", "= the fortress or sanctuary"], "likelyHeard": "the king, though the referent drifts"},
{"id": "88:43", "words": "a direita dos que o oprimem", "readings": ["the right hand (power) of his oppressors", "'a direita' = the political right"], "likelyHeard": "right hand, though the political sense may come to mind"},
{"id": "88:44", "words": "Afastastes o auxílio da sua espada", "readings": ["you withdrew the help his sword should give", "you took help away from his sword", "'sua' = God's sword"], "likelyHeard": "his sword no longer helped him"},

{"id": "88:46", "words": "Abreviastes os dias do seu tempo", "readings": ["you cut short his youth or his lifetime", "you shortened the days of his reign"], "likelyHeard": "shortened his life"},
{"id": "88:47", "words": "vos afastais para sempre", "readings": ["how long will you hide yourself? Forever?", "a contradictory 'how long ... forever'"], "likelyHeard": "sounds contradictory; the meaning is roughly 'will you turn away forever?'"},

{"id": "88:48", "words": "qual é o meu ser", "readings": ["how short my life is", "what my essence/nature is (philosophical)"], "likelyHeard": "'what I am', a vague sense of human frailty"},

{"id": "88:49", "words": "da mão do inferno", "readings": ["from the grave or realm of the dead (Sheol)", "from hell as a place of damnation"], "likelyHeard": "hell as damnation"},
{"id": "88:49", "words": "a sua alma", "readings": ["his own soul/life", "someone else's soul"], "likelyHeard": "his own"},
{"id": "88:50", "words": "como jurastes a Davi", "readings": ["which you swore to David (the mercies promised)", "in the way that you swore"], "likelyHeard": "the mercies you swore to David"},
